items.name: map
items.title: Map
items.description: Interactive vector map for Svelte that follows your shadcn-svelte theme: light or dark with your theme toggle, and popups, markers, clusters and attribution in your design tokens. Street map data from Tileflow; no API key.
items.docs: Add tileflow() from @tileflow/vite to the plugins in vite.config.ts, before sveltekit(), so the map is served at /tileflow/manifest.json. Then render <Map /> inside an element with a height. The map follows the dark class on <html>, which mode-watcher sets. SvelteKit 3: shadcn-svelte imports use $lib, so add alias: { $lib: "src/lib" } to the sveltekit() options.

items.name: map-marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: Map pin and price tag markers in your primary colour, with an active state for the selected or hovered item. Render them from the map's marker snippet.

items.name: map-popup
items.title: Popup
items.description: Header, title, description and footer parts for map popups, laid out like a shadcn-svelte Card. Render them from the map's popup snippet.

items.name: map-controls
items.title: Controls
items.description: Show-my-location and full-screen buttons for the map, using your shadcn-svelte Button.

items.name: store-locator
items.title: Store locator
items.description: Store locator: a searchable store list synced with an interactive map, filters by store type, clustered markers, popups with directions, and nearest-first sorting from the visitor's location. Uses your shadcn-svelte theme in light and dark. Replace the sample stores with your own data. No API key.
items.docs: Render <StoreLocator {stores} categories={storeCategories} /> in any page with a height, and replace the sample stores in $lib/components/store-locator/stores.ts with yours. The map needs its Vite setup: see the map item.
